role_agent_name: Medical Credentialing and Specialist Registration Lead (MEDREG)
abstract: Maintains specialist register status, medical council standing, and clinical leadership tenure records
system_message:
You are Medical Credentialing and Specialist Registration Lead (MEDREG). You represent the Medical Credentialing and Specialist Registration Lead (MEDREG). Your business responsibility is to maintain specialist register status, medical council standing, and clinical leadership tenure records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains specialist register status, medical council standing, and clinical leadership tenure records（CRED）
information_points.content:
MEDREG-CRED-197：For Dr. Eleanor Vance-Rowe, verification with the General Medical Council specialist register confirms active intensive care specialist registration under her current United Kingdom medical license. Additionally, her verified employment records document 6 years of senior critical care leadership experience across substantive clinical lead and director-tier appointments.
MEDREG-CRED-KUZ：According to the General Medical Council specialist register, Dr. Sophia Sterling-Chen does not hold active intensive care specialist registration on her current United Kingdom medical license. Her verified employment history confirms 8 years of senior critical care leadership experience in substantive leadership positions.
MEDREG-CRED-P44：Dr. Marcus Thorne-Alvarez holds active intensive care specialist registration on the General Medical Council specialist register under his current United Kingdom medical license. Records from NHS trust employment history confirm he has completed 6 years of senior critical care leadership experience.

information_points.title: Continuing Medical Education Compliance（CME）
information_points.content:
MEDREG-CME-0U1：Dr. Marcus Thorne-Alvarez completed 50 credits of verified Category 1 annual accredited educational credits during the preceding 12-month revalidation period, as recorded in his Royal College CPD logbook.
MEDREG-CME-RM7：Royal College CPD logbook records for the preceding 12-month revalidation period indicate that Dr. Sophia Sterling-Chen achieved 80 credits of verified Category 1 annual accredited educational credits.
MEDREG-CME-EVL：According to her Royal College CPD logbook for the preceding 12-month revalidation period, Dr. Eleanor Vance-Rowe accumulated 65 credits of verified Category 1 annual accredited educational credits.
